results.detail: Tests prove that case generation yields a behaviour case with a task prompt, a rubric and expected markers for every spec behaviour and trigger, deterministically; that skillz judge without a runner records skipped no runner and exits 0, and with a fake runner and fake judge produces judge.json and judge.md with per-case scores for both sides, a winner and a reason, and that a malformed judge reply is rejected with a clear error rather than a crash; that the judge defaults to the other model when both executables are found on PATH and to the same model otherwise, and the report names which; that skillz challenge with a runner counts a behaviour case the judge scores lower on the candidate as a regression and higher as an improvement, and that skillz package with a runner stores judge results in the version reports and the next regression compares them; that no test ever spawns the real claude or codex; and that docs/evidence contains a judge report produced by a real Claude CLI run whose runner field says claude
